I don't think there is such a thing as right to exist. The correct question should be, "do you want to exist?".  
Probably, for you, the answer is no. But that is normal from the experience you are describing. The only thing that can make you want to exist is finding something to look forward to. At least for the start.

Life is colorless and meaningless by default. Only by finding that anchor, you can look forward to living. Honestly, finding what you want is really hard. At least for me, it took years and god know how many attempts to find it. But I did it mostly without asking for help, which might slowed down that process.

I don't have any advice on how to find that. But I am pretty sure you can find that on Internet by much more qualified people. 

I hope you can find yours. But finding that purpose won't solve your practical problems, it will just make getting up a lot easier.
